Delay bands and comparison with the same municipality

“Esperado” é o resultado que as urnas atrasadas teriam se votassem como as urnas que fecharam no horário no mesmo município. Isso separa o efeito do local (urnas de bairros grandes costumam atrasar) de qualquer outro padrão.

“Expected” is the result the late boxes would have had if they had voted like the boxes that closed on time in the same municipality. This separates the effect of place (boxes in large neighborhoods tend to run late) from any other pattern.
